headline: One decision that everything else is waiting on.
paragraphs: You're carrying a decision that doesn't resolve in an hour. The kind where you need to see it from the outside and from the inside at the same time. A Deep Day creates the conditions for that.

Six to eight hours focused on one thing, whichever thing has been sitting at the edge of your thinking. We look at the decision itself, what's underneath it, and what clarity actually requires in your case so you can take effective action.
You leave knowing what to do and who you need to be for it.
